content: mitmproxy addons register hooks (request/responseheaders/response) and read flow.request.content / flow.response.content; when stream_large_bodies or flow.response.stream=True is set for large bodies, content is empty at hook time -- addons that need full-body access must opt out of streaming for that flow, i.e. addon boundary is whole-buffered-body-in-Python-process, not zero-copy.
